title: Buddy rebuild — re-test the last two

steps.path: The size button in the panel beside the buddy, pressed a few times, quickly too
steps.headline: Does the chat now grow and shrink in one smooth movement from its centre, with no sideways step?
steps.changed: The chat fades out for a moment, the window changes size and place while it is invisible, then the chat grows back in from its centre. The window system cannot change a window's size and place in one step, which was the sideways lurch.
steps.notice: One quick fade-and-grow (about a third of a second) instead of a step left and then a resize.
steps.risk: A brief fade is part of every size change now.

steps.path: Open a menu or the New session form in the buddy, close the buddy's chat, then open it again
steps.headline: After closing and reopening the buddy, are the menus and forms closed, and does New session start from your saved defaults?
steps.changed: Every open now starts the session strip and the no-session screen afresh. The New session form in the session menu now gets your saved defaults (folder, model, skip permissions); before, the buddy never passed them along.
steps.notice: Nothing half-open greets you, and a new session starts in your usual folder with your usual model.
